_comment: Manual target_id -> Bubble _id mappings. Each entry documents the reason. Used by scripts/populate_bubble_tracked_urls.py.

naic.capital_markets_bureau.reason: Two Bubble orgs share the exact name 'Capital Markets Bureau' (sim=1.00 each). Picked the earlier _id as canonical; the other appears to be a duplicate.

naic.e.index.reason: E Committee Index page maps to the parent committee org. Confirmed by WTA empirical output: 77% of 112 alerts were classified as 'Financial Condition (E) Committee'.

naic.ex.index.reason: EX Committee Index page maps to the Executive (EX) Committee. Confirmed by WTA empirical output: 89% of 64 alerts classified as 'Executive (EX) Committee'.

naic.a.index.reason: A Committee Index page maps to the Life Insurance & Annuities (A) Committee. Confirmed by WTA empirical output: top class.

naic.e.reinsurance.index.reason: Reinsurance (E) Index page maps to the Reinsurance (E) Task Force. Confirmed by WTA empirical output: 73% of 86 alerts classified as 'Reinsurance (E) Task Force'.

naic.ae.generator_economic_scenarios_sg.reason: Target label 'Generator Economic Scenarios Subgroup' doesn't paren-strip-match the Bubble name 'Generator of Economic Scenarios (GOES) (E/A) Subgroup (Also under Life Risk-Based Capital (E) Working Group)' due to the 'of' word + trailing '(Also under ...)' annotation. Highest fuzzy match (sim=0.83).

naic.a.latf.vm22sg.reason: Target label 'VM-22 Subgroup (LATF)' uses the acronym VM-22; Bubble org spells it out as 'Valuation Manual (VM)-22 (A) Subgroup'. Only Bubble org matching the VM-22 slug.

naic.ex.rbc_model_governance_tf.bubble_org_name: Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Model Governance (EX) Task Force
naic.ex.rbc_model_governance_tf.reason: Target label 'RBC Model Governance Task Force' drops the 'Risk-Based Capital' prefix. Bubble org spells out both. Clean match (sim=0.81).

naic.ex.climate_resiliency_tf.bubble_org_name: Natural Catastrophe Risk and Resilience (EX) Task Force
naic.ex.climate_resiliency_tf.reason: Target label 'Climate Resiliency Task Force' is stale terminology; the actual NAIC name (and URL slug) is 'Natural Catastrophe Risk and Resilience Task Force'. Confirmed by URL match: target.url is content.naic.org/committees/ex/natural-catastrophe-risk-resilience-tf.
